harness: qa/bots/bot_run.gd (--market, --local-orders, local_focus added in this batch; base strategies unchanged)

steps: Windowed: qa/run_game.sh res://qa/bots/bot_run.gd -- --strategy=decent --seed=2 --market=mil
Seeds 1-5 tried (same result); with --local-orders added, seed 1 peaks at 0.415 at cycle 28.
Read share_rows in the RESULT line: no run has any market above 0.5 at cycle 20 or later (max mil 0.415).
issues.expected: A military-focused player can exceed 50% of one market for 5 cycles from cycle 20 (win), or reach the cycle 40 check above 50%. Design intent: a focused win is reachable.
issues.actual: Peak military share 0.36 to 0.39 at cycles 15 to 17 (5 seeds), 0.415 at cycle 28 with local orders. Five ships (ship_cap 5) cap the volume; the three bots' combined military volume is about 1.5 times the player's at peak. Biotech focus peaks at 0.336 (cycle 22), minerals and luxury stall (see the softlock entries). Decision for the owner: economy-designer to confirm whether a win is meant to be reachable with ship_cap 5.

steps: Windowed: qa/run_game.sh res://qa/bots/bot_run.gd -- --strategy=decent --seed=1 --market=lux
Watch cash_by_cycle: 1200 flat from cycle 1 to 27; routes 0; skills learned only B1 (0 points left).
The idle check flags a softlock from cycle 1; the run is swept at cycle 27.
issues.expected: A player who trades only the luxury market can still start: first routes give skill points, and the cross-system silk lane is reachable with Long Haul (C3).
issues.actual: No route is ever built. The planner finds no same-system silk lane, and the cross-system lane needs C3, which needs points. Points come only from routes touching planets and from new systems (main.gd _award_route, _award_planet, reach_system), so a silk-only player never earns them. Likely cause, not fully verified: UNKNOWN whether the bot planner or the game is the only blocker.

steps: Windowed: qa/run_game.sh res://qa/bots/bot_run.gd -- --strategy=decent --seed=1 --market=min
Watch cash_by_cycle: 300 flat; ships 2 (both bought at cycle 1, one of them the tutorial ship); routes 0; the run is swept at cycle 27.
issues.expected: A minerals-focused player can start trading (dross, nullglass, plate need dead worlds from cycle 15 and skills).
issues.actual: No route and no order from cycle 1; softlock flagged from cycle 1. Before cycle 15 the minerals market has no open lane for this planner. Same root as the lux stall (points need routes). UNKNOWN whether a player without any non-minerals trade is meant to be stuck.

steps: Windowed: qa/run_game.sh res://qa/bots/bot_run.gd -- --strategy=mining_focus --seed=1 --market=min
Two cluster ore lanes are built (lanes_built 2) and both are removed (lanes_removed 2); routes 0 at the end; ships 4 idle; cash 564 flat from cycle 11.
Softlock flagged from cycle 11; swept at cycle 27.
issues.expected: Ore cluster lanes keep running, or the bot keeps trading minerals.
issues.actual: Both routes are removed by cycle 11 (lanes_removed 2) and nothing replaces them. UNKNOWN whether the planner dropped them because no minerals lane passed the 10-cycle payback rule, or the game closed them.

steps: Windowed: qa/run_game.sh res://qa/bots/bot_run.gd -- --strategy=never_expand --seed=1
Run ends END_SWEPT at cycle 27; the end screen is built by end_screen.gd show_ending(ending_id).
Code path checked (not screenshot): title = StoryText.get_or(id + '_TITLE', id); body = get_or(id, 'TODO story: ending text for ' + id).
issues.expected: End screen shows story text for each new ending (END_SWEPT, END_OUTCOMPETED, END_BANKRUPT, END_<MKT>_GOOD).
issues.actual: None of these ids has story text in data/story_text.json. The screen shows the raw id as the title and 'TODO story: ending text for END_SWEPT.' as the body. The same applies to every ending in this build.

steps: Windowed: qa/run_game.sh res://qa/bots/bot_run.gd -- --strategy=never_expand --seed=2 --local-orders
Compare with the same seed without the flag: never_expand_s2 is swept at cycle 27.
With local orders, the one-ship bot ends at the soft END_OUTCOMPETED at cycle 40 with military share 0.247 and cash 1826 (seeds 2 to 5: 0.19 to 0.25).
issues.expected: A one-ship bot with no routes gets swept, as the rule intends for a player who does not spread across markets. UNKNOWN whether local orders are meant to keep a no-route player out of the sweep.
issues.actual: Local Buy and Sell orders (no ship needed) keep the military share above 10%, so the sweep never fires. Sloppy with local orders avoids the sweep in 3 of 3 seeds (soft end at 40); always_expand with local orders in 1 of 2. Local volume can be bought with cash, so it is cash-limited (local_focus alone is swept at cycles 30 to 31).

steps: Windowed: qa/run_game.sh res://qa/bots/bot_run.gd -- --strategy=always_expand --seed=2 --local-orders
Harness warning: route 7 shows 'Not enough cash.' for 3 cycles from cycle 35; route 3 shows 'Waiting for room' for 3 cycles from cycle 39.
issues.expected: Routes do not sit blocked for 3 cycles in a row, or the cause is explained.
issues.actual: Warning streaks reported by the harness. UNKNOWN whether this is a game bug or expected behaviour with stalled storage.

steps: grep -n 'END_REL_\|END_CORP_\|END_LOSS\|Cash goal\|Goal reached in cycle' data/story_text.json
grep -rn 'END_REL\|END_CORP\|END_LOSS' game tools/tests --include='*.gd'  (no hits outside tests and build_story.py)
issues.expected: No goal or Release/Corporation text remains in data/ (story_text.json is built from story/*.md).
issues.actual: About 30 old rows remain in data/story_text.json: END_REL_*, END_CORP_*, END_LOSS ('Cash reached: {cash}. Cash goal: {goal}.'), END_TITLE_REL, END_TITLE_CORP, END_SIGN_*, and the goal line 'Goal reached in cycle {cycle}'. No game code reads them, so they are not visible. story/endings.md still holds them.
